newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: All but one crew of distressed trawler rescued.
newsitem.headline: All but one crew of distressed trawler rescued.

text.p: All but one of 32 fishermen aboard a Bangladeshi fishing trawler that caught fire and sank in the Bay of Bengal have been rescued, the vessel's owners said said on Monday.

"We have only one crew member missing but 31 others, including two Thai nationals, have been rescued by the Bangladesh flagged freighter, Banglar Sampad," an official of Sea Resources Limited told reporters.
He identified the missing crewman as Prakash Ghosh, a Bangladeshi, who is feared drowned.
The trawler, M.V. Heartford, caught fire on Sunday and sank 140 km (87 miles) from Chittagong port.
The owners said a fire broke out in the vessel's engine room but did not identify the cause.
